sn55.47:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme. atha kho nandiyā sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṃṅkhami. …pe…
sn55.47:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nandiyaṃ sakkaṃ bhagavā etadavoca,
sn55.47:1.3: catūhi kho nandiya, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.47:2.2: idha nandiya, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.47:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.47:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.47:2.7: imehi kho nandiya, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
